signal: Phosphorus raised a $27M Series A2 led by Evolution Equity in September 2025, took strategic investment from Neva SGR, and named a new President/COO to scale its xIoT security platform.

email.body1:
Casey, saw Phosphorus closed a $27M Series A2 and brought on a new President and COO to scale xIoT security.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before momentum cools, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Phosphorus off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Casey, quick follow-up for Phosphorus.

Post-raise, the pipeline target usually climbs faster than headcount can, and revenue marketing carries the gap. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to source to hit it, so the shortfall surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings Phosphorus needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Casey, last bit of proof for Phosphorus.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Phosphorus's reply rate likely compares to other cybersecurity startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Casey, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling sourced pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The stretch right after a raise is its own kind of busy, and I know timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your revenue marketing motion? I'll tailor it to Phosphorus either way.
